name: Potion
description: Restores 30 Health. A hunter's most basic and reliable healing item. Combine Herb and Blue Mushroom to make one.

name: Mega Potion
description: Restores 50 Health. An improved Potion that restores more health. Combine a Potion with Honey.

name: Nutrients
description: Temporarily raises maximum Health by up to 10 points. Combine Blue Mushroom and a Godbug.

name: Mega Nutrients
description: Temporarily raises maximum Health by up to 20 points. Combine Nutrients with Honey.

name: Antidote
description: Cures poison. Combine Antidote Herb with Blue Mushroom.

name: Herbal Medicine
description: Cures poison and restores a little health. Combine Cactus Flower with a Bitterbug.

name: Max Potion
description: Fully restores Health and raises it to its maximum. Combine Mega Nutrients with a Dragon Toadstool.

name: Ancient Potion
description: Fully restores Health and Stamina and raises them to their maximum. Combine Immunizer with a Kelbi Horn.

name: Catalyst
description: A base material for various drugs. Combine Honey with a Bitterbug.

name: Immunizer
description: A drug that accelerates health recovery for a time. Combine Catalyst with a Dragon Toadstool.

name: Power Juice
description: Keeps Stamina from decreasing for a time. Combine Catalyst with a Rare Steak.

name: Mega Juice
description: Greatly extends stamina recovery for a time. Combine a Well-Done Steak with Power Extract.

name: Energy Drink
description: Restores Stamina and improves recovery. Combine Honey with a Sunset Herb.

name: Demondrug
description: Temporarily boosts Attack. Combine Catalyst with a Power Seed.

name: Mega Demondrug
description: Temporarily boosts Attack further. Combine Demondrug with Pale Extract.

name: Power Pill
description: Grants a short, large Attack boost. Combine Immunizer with a Power Seed.

name: Armorskin
description: Temporarily boosts Defense. Combine Catalyst with an Armor Seed.

name: Mega Armorskin
description: Temporarily boosts Defense further. Combine Armorskin with Pale Extract.

name: Armor Pill
description: Grants a short, large Defense boost. Combine Immunizer with an Armor Seed.

name: Hot Drink
description: Nullifies cold for a time. Combine a Hot Pepper with a Bitterbug.

name: Hot Meat
description: Eating it nullifies cold for a longer time. Combine a Well-Done Steak with a Hot Pepper.

name: Cool Drink
description: Nullifies heat for a time. Combine an Ice Crystal with a Bitterbug.

name: Cold Meat
description: Eating it nullifies heat for a longer time. Combine a Well-Done Steak with an Ice Crystal.

name: Spicy Mushroom
description: Eating it nullifies cold for a time. Combine a Hot Pepper with a Special Mushroom.

name: Frozen Berry
description: Eating it nullifies heat for a time. Combine a Tropical Berry with an Ice Crystal.

name: Thawing Agent
description: Thaws a hunter that has been frozen. Combine a Fire Herb with a Rumblefish.

name: Poisoned Meat
description: Meat laced with poison. Combine Raw Meat with a Toadstool.

name: Tainted Meat
description: Meat laced with a paralysis agent. Combine Raw Meat with a Parashroom.

name: Drugged Meat
description: Meat laced with a sleep agent. Combine Raw Meat with a Sleep Herb.

name: Bomb Material
description: A base material for making bombs. Combine a Sap Plant with a Stone.

name: Deodorant
description: Removes the Unique Stench status. Combine Bomb Material with a Sunset Herb.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Releases smoke that causes monsters to lose sight of you. Combine Bomb Material with Ivy.

name: Poison Smoke Bmb
description: Releases poisonous smoke. Combine Bomb Material with a Toadstool.

name: Flash Bomb
description: Creates a blinding flash. Combine Bomb Material with a Flashbug.

name: Dung Bomb
description: Repels monsters with a foul stench. Combine Bomb Material with Dung.

name: Paintball
description: Marks a monster on the map for a time. Combine a Sap Plant with a Paintberry.

name: Farcaster
description: Returns the user to base instantly. Combine Bomb Material with an Exciteshroom.

name: Gunpowder
description: Explosive powder used in many items. Combine a Fire Herb with a Nitroshroom.

name: Sm Barrel-Bomb
description: A small barrel bomb. Combine a Small Barrel with a Fire Herb.

name: Sm Barrel-Bomb+
description: An upgraded small barrel bomb. Combine a Small Barrel Bomb with a Burst Arrowana.

name: Lg Barrel-Bomb
description: A large barrel bomb. Combine Gunpowder with a Large Barrel.

name: Lg Barrel-Bomb+
description: An upgraded large barrel bomb. Combine a Large Barrel Bomb with a Scatterfish.

name: Lightning Rod
description: A rod that conducts thunder, useful against certain monsters. Combine a Burst Arrowana with a Thunderbug.
